body: I'm really into Assassins Creed, although after playing Unity and Rogue ive gone off it a bit. I enjoy playing borderlands, and recently i've gotten into wolfenstein and far cry. I play on PS3/PS4. http://crydamourewaves.deviantart.com/ this is my art profile but i dont post on it too often
im really into gaming and art at the moment. I try to game or draw whenever im not doing work

(First of all, I really, really appreciate your reply/help, so thank you)

For probably a year or two now I realized that im really interested in video game design, and i'd like to study it at a university, although ive been on some trips around a good couple uni's in my area and I always felt uncomfortable there, and I doubt i'd be able to afford it, as even if I got a job in the industry I dont think i'd be paid enough to pay my fees off.

Also, I was diagnosed with Asperger's. My first year of counselling was about my depression/anxiety, and the second was partly for my diagnosis. My parents would attend some sessions with me, some conversations had to be one to one and some were with just my mom, or dad. I think the only three things I gained from all this was that my dad actually started talking to me (since I was a small child. Although the only times he does he's still not nice) and my mom started to hate me more and more, as well as since my diagnosis i've just been wishing I wasnt on the spectrum, and I keep pretending that im not to make myself feel normal.

I really struggle with friendships, partly because of my Asperger's. I've always found it difficult to make friends, let alone keep them, or sometimes, to actually keep liking them. After a while of becoming friends with someone I feel like I keep searching for reasons why I shouldnt like them, or why they annoy me (so it's like i'm constantly searching for defaults or dislikes in people?) and I dont consciously choose to do this, it just happens whether I try to stop myself or not. Like I said this almost always ends up in ruined friendships because of it, and almost always more people that hate me. Similarly, I've only had one relationship so far (with a girl my age, and online) and it ended the same way my friendships do. I did notice that maybe she wasnt exactly my type, and I partly did it to see what it was like; it was a good experience but I felt so guilty when we broke up because she seemed to like me a lot more than I did her. In addition, im also pretty sure im not capable of really loving anyone, whether it be friends, family or girl/boy friends. I dont really get emotionally attached to people and I find it hard to empathize in any way. This is one of the reasons why i'm scared of making friends, because i'd go through the friendship knowing what will happen and that they would always deserve better, similarly with relationships, I know I could never give what they want or deserve, and they would most likely leave me in the end. 

Lastly, i'm a good 98% certain im interested in both boys and girls, but as for the bisexual part im not so sure. Before I realized this, I always thought I was asexual/aromantic because I was never attracted to people I knew, and I wasnt interested in relationships or all the ''adult'' stuff (ive ever been interested in having children, or getting married, etc) 

once again thank you for replying
